title: The National Commission on The Rights of Child Amendment Act 2022

sections.shortTitle: The National Commission on The Rights of Child Amendment Act 2022
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE NATIONAL COMMISSION ON THE RIGHTS OF CHILD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2022
THE
NATIONAL COMMISSION ON THE RIGHTS OF CHILD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2022
Acts,
Ordinances, President s Orders and Regulations
SENATE
SECRETARIAT
Islamabad,
the 14th January, 2022
No. F.
9(47)/2021-Legis. The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 13th January, 2022 and is hereby
published for general information:
ACT
NO.1 OF 2022
An Act
to amend the National Commission on the Rights of Child Act, 2017
WHEREAS,
it is expedient to amend the National Commission on the Rights of Child Act, 2017 (XXXII of
2017) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:
1.
Short title and commencement. (1) This Act shall be called the
National Commission on the Rights of Child (Amendment) Act, 2022.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
